question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Enmity
solution:
The correct answer is **"Hostility."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Enmity"** means hostility or hatred. (शत्रुता, वैर, दुश्‍मनी)

 
 
• **Example**: *Despite their past **enmity**__, the two leaders decided to work together for the greater good.*
 
 
 
• Synonyms of **enmity** include **hostility, animosity, antipathy, and hatred**.
 
• **"Hostility" **means very strong feelings against somebody/something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के प्रति अत्‍यंत उग्र भावनाएँ; शत्रुता)
 __
 
• **Example**: *She didn’t say anything but I could sense her **hostility**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 __ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Probability (Option 1)** means the likelihood of something happening. ((किसी बात की) संभावना)
 
• **Pretext (Option 2) **means a false reason given to justify an action or decision. (बहाना, हीला)
 
• **Variability (Option 3)** means the quality or state of being variable or changeable. (परिवर्तनशील, परिवर्तनीयता)
